activity_log:
CREATE TABLE activity_log (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	entity_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	entity_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	action VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	changes JSON, 
	snapshot JSON NOT NULL, 
	actor VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	actor_id VARCHAR(255), 
	metadata JSON, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
CREATE INDEX ix_activity_log_user_created ON activity_log (user_id, created_at)
CREATE INDEX ix_activity_log_user_entity ON activity_log (user_id, entity_type, entity_id)
entities:
CREATE TABLE entities (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	entity_type VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	custom_type VARCHAR(100), 
	notes TEXT, 
	tags JSON NOT NULL, 
	aka JSON NOT NULL, 
	source_repo TEXT, 
	source_files JSON, 
	source_url TEXT, 
	confidence FLOAT, 
	encoding_agent TEXT, 
	encoding_version TEXT, 
	agent_id TEXT, 
	agent_version TEXT, 
	agent_model TEXT, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
entity_project_association:
CREATE TABLE entity_project_association (
	entity_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	project_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (entity_id, project_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(entity_id) REFERENCES entities (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
entity_relationships:
CREATE TABLE entity_relationships (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	source_entity_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	target_entity_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	relationship_type VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	strength FLOAT, 
	confidence FLOAT, 
	relationship_metadata JSON, 
	source_repo TEXT, 
	source_files JSON, 
	source_url TEXT, 
	encoding_agent TEXT, 
	encoding_version TEXT, 
	agent_id TEXT, 
	agent_version TEXT, 
	agent_model TEXT, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(source_entity_id) REFERENCES entities (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(target_entity_id) REFERENCES entities (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_entity_relationships_unique ON entity_relationships (source_entity_id, target_entity_id, relationship_type)
memories:
CREATE TABLE memories (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	title TEXT NOT NULL, 
	content TEXT NOT NULL, 
	context TEXT NOT NULL, 
	keywords JSON NOT NULL, 
	tags JSON NOT NULL, 
	importance INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	source_repo TEXT, 
	source_files JSON, 
	source_url TEXT, 
	confidence FLOAT, 
	encoding_agent TEXT, 
	encoding_version TEXT, 
	agent_id TEXT, 
	agent_version TEXT, 
	agent_model TEXT, 
	is_obsolete BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	obsolete_reason TEXT, 
	superseded_by INTEGER, 
	obsoleted_at DATETIME, 
	access_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	last_accessed_at DATETIME, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(superseded_by) REFERENCES memories (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)
memory_entity_association:
CREATE TABLE memory_entity_association (
	memory_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	entity_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (memory_id, entity_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(memory_id) REFERENCES memories (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(entity_id) REFERENCES entities (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
memory_links:
CREATE TABLE memory_links (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	source_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	target_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(source_id) REFERENCES memories (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(target_id) REFERENCES memories (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_memory_links_source_target ON memory_links (source_id, target_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_memory_links_target_source ON memory_links (target_id, source_id)
memory_project_association:
CREATE TABLE memory_project_association (
	memory_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	project_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (memory_id, project_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(memory_id) REFERENCES memories (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
projects:

	status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	repo_name VARCHAR(255), 
	last_encoding_point VARCHAR(255), 
	notes TEXT, 
	source_repo TEXT, 
	source_files JSON, 
	source_url TEXT, 
	confidence FLOAT, 
	encoding_agent TEXT, 
	encoding_version TEXT, 
	agent_id TEXT, 
	agent_version TEXT, 
	agent_model TEXT, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
users:
CREATE TABLE users (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	external_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	idp_metadata JSON, 
	notes TEXT, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_users_external_id ON users (external_id)
